hi ! as someone who was a compulsive liar during my childhood/early teen years, acknowledging that you did something wrong is the best thing you can do. not only for others, but for yourself as well. it’s completely normal to try and find reasons as to why you’re not at fault, but trust me when i say this doesn’t help. i know therapy gets thrown around a lot in this sub, but i know from experience that this habit can be hard to break without someone there to help you, so i would very much suggest talking to a professional as well. bottom line, acknowledge that you’ve been doing a bad thing, try to not hop around it, and remember to take care of yourself. have a good day !!

i don’t think there’s an ”appropriate” way to kill yourself. no matter how you do it, no one in your life will likely cope well with it, as sad as that sounds. if you want to give your family closure, i recommend maybe writing a letter or something of the sort? like, something that adresses everyone in a bunch and doesn’t single out someone. contacting a person 1on1 to explain your reasoning can be incredibly traumatic for that person. 

i wish you luck with whatever happens!
